dog.description_text:
💕 HAILEY
🐶 Female | 4 months old | 8.6 lbs.
🐾 Yorkie Mix

Tiny girl. BIG zoomies. Even bigger snuggles. 😂💕

Hailey came into rescue after her owner reached out and asked if we could take her. And if she looks a little familiar, there's a reason—Hailey is Mochi's sister, who made her way to New Jersey at the end of July!

This little 8-pound girl is an absolute blast.

When Hailey gets excited, she doesn't just play—SHE TAKES OFF!
dog.name: HAILEY
